HPPSC Assistant Professor Provisional Answer Key 2026 - Download Objection Process at hppsc.hp.gov.in - Complete Details

HPPSC has released the provisional answer key for Paper-I of the Assistant Professor Public Administration screening test held on 16 September 2026. Check the important objection dates (18 to 22 September 2026), the ₹100 per-question non-refundable fee, the online-only objection process, document requirements, contact numbers, and the complete 50-question answer key inside this article.

Important Dates

  • Notice Date : 17 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 16 September 2026
  • Date of screening test (Paper-I) : 16 September 2026 (11:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)
  • Notice/answer key upload date : 17 September 2026

Application Fee

  • Post : Assistant Professor (College Cadre) - Public Administration
  • Date of screening test (Paper-I) : 16 September 2026 (11:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
